nodes.summary: An element of a torsion-free algebra that vanishes under every algebra homomorphism into an algebraically closed field is zero, provided the tensor product with the fraction field is reduced and finite.
nodes.title: Geometric points detect elements when the generic fiber is reduced

nodes.summary: If the scalar-extended evaluation map is injective, a tensor vanishing at all pairs of selected algebraic points is zero. The algebra and the point index may be infinite; no closedness or perfection assumption is needed.
nodes.title: A tensor vanishing at all pairs of algebraic points is zero

nodes.summary: A unital, multiplicatively consistent assignment on generators extends to an algebra homomorphism when it preserves every finite linear relation.
nodes.title: Algebra maps from relation-preserving generator assignments

nodes.summary: A ring character extends to the algebra generated by another ring image when its kernel contains the first kernel and a separating family of linear forms takes prime-subfield values on that image.
nodes.title: Extending a ring character via prime-subfield-valued linear forms

nodes.summary: A homomorphism from `R` to an algebraically closed field extends to an integral extension `S` with any prescribed prime kernel lying over `ker χ`.
nodes.title: Lifting maps to algebraically closed fields along integral extensions

nodes.summary: Over an algebraically closed field, the number of algebra homomorphisms from an étale algebra to the base field equals its rank.
nodes.title: Counting algebra homomorphisms from an étale algebra

nodes.summary: A finite reduced algebra over an algebraically closed field has `finrank` many algebra homomorphisms to the field.
nodes.title: Counting algebra homomorphisms of a finite reduced algebra

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
